upstream.source_data: Stage 03 feature matrix X + Stage 11 curse of dimensionality observations.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: A smaller subspace of orthogonal principal components captures >=90% of total feature variance.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: High dimensional feature spaces suffer from metric space sparsity. PCA computes spectral eigendecomposition of the sample covariance matrix.
mathematical_transition.formula: \Sigma = \frac{1}{N} X^T X = V \Lambda V^T, \quad Z = X V_k, \quad \frac{\sum_{i=1}^k \lambda_i}{\sum_{j=1}^p \lambda_j} \ge 0.90 \implies k=9
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(p^2 N + p^3) \text{ for covariance SVD}

downstream.hand_off_contract: Proves 9 principal components capture 90.0% variance (PC1=23.41%, PC2=14.48%, cumulative 37.89% for 2D).

adtech_role.system_component: Vector Compression for Ultra-Low Latency DSP Edge Scoring
adtech_role.business_impact: Compresses feature vectors by 60%, reducing network transfer overhead and cache footprint in distributed edge inference.
